description: This file implements a gRPC server for the Casimir control service, handling commands such as setting power levels, radio states, polling NFC, and sending APDU commands. It manages connection initialization, radio state toggling, and communication with the Casimir device, exposing these functionalities via gRPC endpoints.

classes.name: CasimirControlServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the gRPC service for Casimir control, providing methods to set power level, radio state, poll NFC, and send APDU/broadcast commands.

methods.name: SetPowerLevel
methods.description: Sets the power level of the Casimir device.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the connection to the Casimir device.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the connection with the Casimir device.

methods.name: Mute
methods.description: Mutes the radio on the Casimir device.

methods.name: Unmute
methods.description: Unmutes the radio on the Casimir device.

methods.name: SetRadioState
methods.description: Sets the radio state (on/off) of the Casimir device.

methods.name: PollA
methods.description: Polls the NFC and retrieves a sender ID.

methods.name: SendApdu
methods.description: Sends an APDU command to the Casimir device.

methods.name: SendBroadcast
methods.description: Sends a broadcast command via the Casimir device.

methods.name: RunServer
methods.description: Starts the gRPC server to listen for incoming requests.
